import unittest
from solution import grade_responses


class GradeResponsesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_grades_every_item_after_an_incorrect_response(self):
        items = [
            {"prompt": "one", "expected": 1},
            {"prompt": "two", "expected": 2},
            {"prompt": "three", "expected": 3},
        ]
        result = grade_responses(items, [1, 99, 3])
        self.assertEqual(result, {
            "score": 2,
            "total": 3,
            "details": [
                {"prompt": "one", "response": 1, "correct": True},
                {"prompt": "two", "response": 99, "correct": False},
                {"prompt": "three", "response": 3, "correct": True},
            ],
        })

    def test_empty_lists(self):
        self.assertEqual(grade_responses([], []), {"score": 0, "total": 0, "details": []})

    def test_responses_are_deep_copied(self):
        response = {"nested": [[1]]}
        responses = [response]
        result = grade_responses([{"prompt": "p", "expected": {"nested": [[1]]}}], responses)
        self.assertTrue(result["details"][0]["correct"])
        response["nested"][0].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(result["details"][0]["response"], {"nested": [[1]]})
        result["details"][0]["response"]["nested"][0].append(3)
        self.assertEqual(responses[0], {"nested": [[1, 2]]})

    def test_inputs_are_not_mutated(self):
        items = [{"prompt": "p", "expected": [1]}]
        responses = [[1]]
        grade_responses(items, responses)
        self.assertEqual(items, [{"prompt": "p", "expected": [1]}])
        self.assertEqual(responses, [[1]])

    def test_invalid_top_level_inputs_and_length(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            grade_responses((), [])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            grade_responses([], ())
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            grade_responses([], [1])

    def test_all_items_are_validated_before_comparison(self):
        class ComparisonProbe:
            def __init__(self):
                self.compared = False
            def __eq__(self, other):
                self.compared = True
                return True
        probe = ComparisonProbe()
        items = [{"prompt": "valid", "expected": probe}, {"prompt": "", "expected": 1}]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            grade_responses(items, [probe, 1])
        self.assertFalse(probe.compared)

    def test_invalid_item_shapes(self):
        invalid_items = [
            [42],
            [{}],
            [{"prompt": "p"}],
            [{"prompt": "p", "expected": 1, "extra": 2}],
            [{"prompt": "", "expected": 1}],
            [{"prompt": 3, "expected": 1}],
        ]
        for items in invalid_items:
            with self.subTest(items=items):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    grade_responses(items, [None])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
